units.source_text: 她若无其事地信手写成，笔致非常优美。

en.t: She wrote it off casually, as though nothing were the matter, and her brushwork was extraordinarily graceful.

units.source_text: 薰君看了，觉得要对她怀恨而与之断绝，毕竟是不可能的。

en.t: When Lord Kaoru saw it, he felt that, after all, it would be impossible to resent her and break with her.

units.source_text: 他想：“大女公子屡次说‘她是我的同胞手足，我愿将一切让给她’，

en.t: He thought, The elder princess said again and again, She is my own sister, and I would gladly yield everything to her,

units.source_text: 我没有答应她，想必她抱怨我，因此昨夜做此布置吧。

en.t: but I did not consent, so she must have blamed me and made these arrangements last night because of it.

units.source_text: 我忽视她的好意，对小女公子如此冷淡，

en.t: I disregarded her kindness and treated the younger princess so coldly,

units.source_text: 她一定把我看作薄情人。

en.t: so she must surely think of me as a heartless man.

units.source_text: 因此我最初的愿望更加难于成遂了。

en.t: Because of that, my first wish has become even harder to fulfill.

units.source_text: 从中传话的那个老侍女，也一定把我看作轻薄儿。

en.t: That old gentlewoman who carried messages between us must also see me as a frivolous man.

units.source_text: 总之，起了色情之念，已经悔之莫及。

en.t: In any case, it is too late now to regret having given rise to such amorous thoughts.

units.source_text: 决心舍弃俗世而自己不能抑制欲念，已足于被天下人耻笑。

en.t: Having resolved to abandon the world, yet being unable to restrain my own desires, is already enough to make all people laugh at me.

units.source_text: 何况效法世间一般好色之徒，只管缠绕一个对我无情的女子，

en.t: How much more so if, imitating the common lechers of the world, I simply keep clinging to a woman who has no feeling for me,

units.source_text: 更将被世人笑我是‘无篷一小舟’了。”

en.t: then people will laugh at me all the more as a little boat without a canopy.
He turned these thoughts over and over until dawn.

units.source_text: 趁残月犹明、晓色清幽之时，

en.t: While the lingering moon was still bright and the dawn light was clear and quiet,

units.source_text: 便前往访问兵部卿亲王。

en.t: he went off to visit Prince Hyobukyo.
